title: The own map area step reads a real column, is proved on PostgreSQL, and a far converted layer gets one too
runtime: none; one throwaway PostGIS container (image 01a6a70e41e6, 127.0.0.1:25440, no volume), removed after the run

bug.what: SELECT name,plan_ref FROM usp_intake_items; the table has no name column, so every admission tick of a far raster or point cloud rolled back with SQLSTATE 42703 (rehearsal 2 run 3, docs/evidence/step-9/s9-2/result-c.json)
bug.fix: coalesce(s.name,i.member_path) from the item joined to its source, as the intake manifest (intake-service.ts itemSelect) names an item
bug.whyTestsMissedIt: S9.4d tests answered SQL with a fake database
bug.regression: the gated test fails 3 of 6 subtests on the old read (admission records an issue, no own area) and passes all on the fix

gatedTest.env: ULPIN_PG_TEST_URL, skipped when unset; host must be 127.0.0.1; its own database, created then dropped WITH (FORCE)
gatedTest.order: database/sql/00-bootstrap/postgis.sql, then the server's migrate() (core, registry, areas, officer, officer AI, spatial ML, USP)
gatedTest.rows: generated test_only cases, sources, items, parts and corners in an arbitrary UTM 43N frame
covers: admitIntakeSurfaceParts with a far item: the far flag, createOwnAreaTx, caseAreas; own area named from the source, its own site, placed on_map, no second area on a later tick
the moved key: a changed batch extent re-settles the item and placedOn follows; a fresh settle keeps the same key
settleSurfaceItemTx and surfacePartPlacementTx for a near item in the batch area and a far part in its own area (corners from the own origin; not placed against the batch area)
sourcePartOwnAreaTx: a UTM-sized footprint gets EPSG:32643, a too-wide one EPSG:3857, an unresolved EPSG none
step 3: beyondAreaOriginTx far and near, farLayerAreaTx makes one area and a retry returns the same one, a near layer makes none, layerArea chooses the own area or the batch area

changed: intake-large-worker.ts draft: before a converted layer's first cut (a source with nativeDerivative lineage, no stored cut, a batch area with a reference), its first published chunk's feature corners are checked against the batch area's 50 km rule (source-building-import.ts beyondAreaOriginTx, PostGIS ST_Transform to the area's analysis CRS minus its origin)

a far layer gets one map area of its own via sourcePartOwnAreaTx (its own site; UTM rule, else EPSG:3857), recorded on its source as inspection.intakeOwnArea.areaId; the fold is read again and the packages are cut against that area's reference
foldContext takes its destination from layerArea: the recorded own area, else the batch area (intakeCaseArea), so a retry drafts into the same area

a layer within the batch area, a non-derived file and a batch area without a reference keep today's path; the STALE_REVISION branch and intake-draft-worker.ts are unchanged (native derivatives are large originals and are drafted only by the large worker)
farConvertedLayer.displayOnly: the own area's reference is display only, as S9.4d; source coordinates are never moved or changed
farConvertedLayer.gap: persistPreparedAreaImport (areas.ts, not owned) binds the retained case to the package area's site; a batch case already bound to the batch site is refused AREA_SOURCE_DENIED for the own area until areas.ts skips that bind for the area recorded on the source
